gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-stack-sans-headli: Wide-margined drama: Metamorphous sets its midline high and softens every shift between fat and slim strokes. Stack Sans Headline keeps a single monoline skeleton, with no brush-like swelling and a deep middle band that holds tiny sizes crisp.
gen-gf-offside-gf-stack-sans-notch: Stack Sans Notch is rod-stock simple, every stroke cut to identical thickness. Offside holds a level, widely tracked beat with curves that refuse to close, so a larger size for it than the big-bodied body text feels natural.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-sarpanch: Scattered and shouty, Paprika lets lowercase fill the line like capitals. Sarpanch carries a full page of paragraphs comfortably, its open-mouthed e and compact ascender gap keeping lines tight and friendly.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Noto Sans Tirhuta is contemporary and clean, dominated by a big x-height. Across paragraphs its cut-back terminals leave generous gaps, while Eater, dark and wide-spaced, stays the rougher, more aggressive voice.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Flavors towers on a stubby, pencil-stroke x-height, its diagonals carrying the heft of the stems. And Noto Sans Ugaritic reads easily over paragraphs, its open letter mouths and near-equal x-height and cap height keeping lines compact.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-sulphur-point: Goldman sets round forms like open parentheses, with generous clearance between letters. Sulphur Point then settles into a marker-like, constant line, its bulky lowercase and open gaps keeping a full page of text sturdy and clear.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-yaldevi: Yaldevi keeps its lowercase outsized, with an e whose eye opens clearly to the right. But Grandstander has the standout quality, bold constant-width lines whose crossbars weigh exactly what the stems do.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-vend-sans: Vend Sans draws a ruler-drawn, constant-width line, its curves ending in wide, unclosed terminals. Metamorphous does the commanding work, with big sidebearings and strokes that lighten mildly toward the ends, while Vend Sans handles the steady running text.
gen-gf-phudu-fs-public-sans: Bold, open-curved lettering: Phudu draws a pressure-free, ballpoint line. What lifts the pair is the lowercase height, moderate in Phudu and high in Public Sans, a trustworthy sans-serif with broad open counters.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-orbit: Orbit lets every character float apart, its curves stopping short instead of closing in. Orbit keeps a rope-like consistency, and if Phudu were made small its bold, open curves would lose their punch.
